purpose: P03 RGB copy accounting and documented allocation sites

hardware_crop.archive_observation: One archived hardware RGB crop fixture frame per listed codec.
hardware_crop.archive_check: compared compact cropped RGB rows byte for byte to the same decoded RGB frame before cropping; checked visible edge markers and distinct padded pixels
hardware_crop.binary_attribution: The color-smoke endpoint build hashes describe the network color trials. The separate crop probe is named by its command filter.

observation.geometry_attribution: One session with fixed configured geometry. Each included window reports the same last source and encoded dimensions, CPU RGB route, and matching hardware stage counts.

derived_from_observed_current_copy_count.baseline_total_scope: Counterfactual from the baseline code, without an old-binary soak.

reference_hardware_cpu_rgb_frame.software_transfer_destination: Retained while its hardware context matches.

allocation_sites_from_source.scope: Counts are named source-site operations. Context changes, pool misses, reserves, actual storage identity, all allocator calls, conversion writes, compressed-packet copies, hardware download bytes and uploads are separate.
allocation_sites_from_source.jpeg_vs_baseline: Whole-JPEG decode calls the existing pool in both references. The network tile implementation has the same blob. Existing unit regressions show storage reuse and isolation; the soak provides no JPEG allocation or copy measurements.

source.scope: Git baseline versus stable staged-verification source reference. The hardware artifacts separately identify their build as a later working tree and provide binary hashes. The source reference pins the named-site logic; it does not identify the exact archived binaries.
